games.title: FAULTLINE
games.tagline: Hill driving on ground that moves under you.
games.description: Hills heave up, slopes slump, faults slip and the tide floods the low road. Every change glows orange a few seconds before it moves, so you can read it and pick your speed. Carry tremor charges to move the ground yourself: a ramp on the flat, a dip on a slope, or a pit under a rival.

games.hold: the climber model's licence is unknown (see rope-team/THIRD_PARTY.md)
games.title: ROPE TEAM
games.tagline: Climb a mountain on one shared rope.
games.description: Co-op climbing for one to four people tied to the same rope. When one of you slips, the others have to hold on. Climb with bots straight away; rooms with friends need the game's server.

games.title: HEXHAUL
games.tagline: Shove your friends off a sinking island.
games.description: A party brawler for two to eight players on an island of hex tiles that keeps sinking. Pull up tiles, carry them, build bridges, and push everyone else into the sea. Practice and two-player Local work in the page.
games.online: Online play needs the Node server

games.title: SKYFARM
games.tagline: Grow a garden in the sky, then glide to the next island.
games.description: Till, plant, water and harvest on a floating island, cook what you grow, and open a glider to cross the gaps to the islands beyond. Plays solo here; co-op for up to four runs on its own server.

games.title: TIDEFALL
games.tagline: The sea goes out. Raid the ruins before it comes back.
games.description: Teams race onto the seabed while the tide is out, grab what the ruins hold and get it back to camp before the water returns. Practice mode fills the teams with bots.
games.online: Online play needs the Node server

games.title: BREACH
games.tagline: A fast arena shooter with five weapons and five-minute rounds.
games.description: Two to eight players, five weapons and short rounds on tight arena maps. Practice puts you against bots at the skill you pick.
games.online: Online play needs the Node server

games.title: NIGHT MARKET
games.tagline: Run a street-food market where the staff and regulars are the game.
games.description: Buy stalls along a street, hire staff and watch the regulars come back night after night. Every person has a name and a mood, and you can click anyone to see what they are up to.

games.title: ORBITAL
games.tagline: Place worlds, bend the comet's path, reach the light.
games.description: A gravity puzzle. Drag planets and stars onto the grid, launch the comet and watch their pull bend its flight towards the goal.

games.title: REWIND HEIST
games.tagline: Every loop you play is replayed by a ghost of your past self.
games.description: A time-loop stealth heist. You never have enough time on your own, so each loop adds another ghost of you that repeats what you did. Put your past selves to work, crack the vault and get the gold out.

games.title: NEON RUSH
games.tagline: A synthwave runner on an endless neon track.
games.description: Switch lanes, double-jump and drop fast to stay on a track that never ends. Swipe controls on phones.

games.title: DECOY
games.tagline: Prop hunt: hide as furniture or hunt whoever did.
games.description: Prop hunt for four to ten players: hiders become objects around the map while hunters look for anything out of place. Practice plays with bots. Still being built.
games.online: Online play needs the Node server

games.title: PAPER PLANES
games.tagline: Paper-plane tag in a giant room where the air is the terrain.
games.description: You are a paper plane in a giant room and the air is the terrain: ride a radiator thermal, slingshot through a fan blast, dodge a window gust, and tag (or flee) the plane covered in ink. Nothing has an engine, so you only go where the air lets you. Practice plays with bots. Still being built.
